evidence.section: Full-paper method / memory representation and retrieval

evidence.paraphrase: New entities and relations are incrementally added. For RoboEXP, this specifically supports fixed-rule insertion or replacement of metric and semantic scene state.
Interaction corrects object state records. For RoboEXP, this specifically supports fixed-rule correction of stored state of metric and semantic scene state.
During operation, RoboEXP applies relinking or reindexing of stored items to metric and semantic scene state; the memory state changes while the governing update policy remains fixed.
During operation, RoboEXP applies explicit deletion or eviction of stored items to metric and semantic scene state; the memory state changes while the governing update policy remains fixed.

derived.hybrid_relation: Distinct operative representation paths are explicitly linked for downstream retrieval, reasoning, or control.

adjudication_notes: Strict-tier full-paper review (PDF p. 4): During inference, the operative memory component (metric and semantic scene state) changes through fixed-rule insertion or replacement, fixed-rule correction of stored state, relinking or reindexing of stored items, explicit deletion or eviction of stored items; the governing policy remains fixed, and any learning reported by the paper occurs before deployment. Training-time learning, when present, was not counted as T3.
